summary: V493 lets a gamma deposit's hotkey spend at a service and migrates deposits and services to remove the old spender. It adds optional coldkey-funded commitment burns, per-mechanism weight delegation, sudo basket controls with legacy defaults, and an Etao owner-update limit of 360 blocks. The transaction version is 2 because gamma removes and renumbers calls. Release workflows announce upgrades and stable Python releases, with stable publishing through the mainnet watcher.
